primary_purpose: Describe inflammatory-cell-rich structural injury and its anatomical distribution as an orthogonal context for the settled confocal KRT5-pod and epithelial-state results.
hard_rules: Review the whole section before consulting any supporting region tile.
The section score is the primary review unit; supporting tiles are evidence locators, not independent replicates.
H&E may support a cellular-infiltration or structural-injury interpretation but cannot identify immune lineage.
H&E cannot identify a KRT5-positive pod. Pod identity remains an IF endpoint.
Airway, vessel, and alveolar reference space must be distinguished before compartment-specific injury is scored.
Artifact or unresolved anatomy is not converted to a negative lesion call.
The reviewer must remain blinded to mouse, genotype, infection, and IF measurements during primary scoring.

anatomy_reference.airway: A circular or branching lumen with a comparatively continuous epithelial cell-nuclear lining.
anatomy_reference.alveolar_parenchyma: A sponge-like network of many small airspaces separated by thin septa.
anatomy_reference.vessel: A thin-walled elongated, slit-like, or partly collapsed lumen with an endothelial nuclear lining; red blood cells may support but do not define the call.
anatomy_reference.mixed: More than one reference space is materially represented.
anatomy_reference.unresolved: The available view does not support a reliable reference-space assignment.

review_sequence.name: technical_acceptability
review_sequence.question: Is enough approved, in-focus tissue visible to score this section?

review_sequence.name: whole_section_inflammation_extent
review_sequence.question: What fraction of usable tissue contains abnormal inflammatory-cell-rich or consolidated morphology?

scale.1: rare or focal; less than 10% of usable tissue

review_sequence.name: compartment_specific_injury
review_sequence.question: Score abnormal cell-rich inflammation in alveolar/interstitial, peribronchial, and perivascular reference spaces separately.

scale.uncertain: reference space or injury is unresolved

review_sequence.name: structural_injury
review_sequence.question: Score consolidation/airspace loss and airway epithelial injury or luminal debris separately.

review_sequence.name: evidence_and_confidence
review_sequence.question: Record representative region IDs, the dominant pattern, confidence, and any limitation.

reportability.maximum_claim: Blinded descriptive section scores after completion and QC.
Descriptive mouse summary; current cohort cannot support group inference.
Qualitative/descriptive concordance at mouse level only.
